tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
To qualify award of this contract Tenderer should Submit the Individual/Firm/Company Registration Certificates issued by The Competent Authority (Scanned copy of Original Documents)
Karnataka Labor Department Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)(Scanned copy of Original Documents)
GST Registration Certificate and PAN card (Scanned copy of Original Documents)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed one similar nature of Contract of Value not less than Rs 5.00 Lakhs or Supply Minimum of 02 nos of outsource to Municiapl dept any Govt Dept in any one of the last three financial year in single work order, ie 2021-22 to 2023-24
Karnataka Labour Department Registration Certificate for not less than 15 nos (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)
Provident Fund (PF) Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)
ESI Registration Certificate (Valid certificate of Agency Issued by the Competent Authority)

Tenderer should submit a Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 1.50 Lakhs Credit lines or letters of credit or Certificates from Nationalized Banks for meeting the Fund requirement etc (Certificate must be as per Finance Department Circular No FD CAAM 16 2022 (P 2) Dated 22 08 2022 should be taken after the date of Tender Published date in the prescribed format)
IT Returns for the last Three Years (2021-22 to 2023-24)
Tenderer in its name should achieved in at least two Financial year a minimum Financial Turnover of Rs. 10.00 Lakhs, in last Three years ie 2021-22 to 2023-24
